people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Riblah
people.line: Babylonian headquarters during the conquest of Judah

people.name: Zedekiah
people.line: Last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile

translations.web: The king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. He also killed all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
translations.bsb: There at Riblah the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and he also killed all the officials of Judah.
translations.kjv: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
translations.asv: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
